mapper.update: UPDATE trip_task SET stage = 'generating', progress = 10, message = '正在生成行程', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'processing' AND stage = 'submitted'
UPDATE trip_task SET stage = 'saving', progress = 80, message = '正在校验并保存行程', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'processing'

UPDATE trip_task SET status = 'completed', stage = 'completed', progress = 100, message = '旅行计划生成成功', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'processing'

UPDATE trip_task SET status = 'failed', stage = 'failed', progress = 100, message = #{message}, error_code = #{code}, error_message = #{message}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'processing'

UPDATE trip_task SET status = 'failed', stage = 'failed', progress = 100, message = '任务超时或服务中断，请使用新的幂等键重试', error_code = 'TASK_EXPIRED', error_message = '任务超时或服务中断', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), lock_version = lock_version + 1 WHERE status = 'processing' AND ( (started_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at < TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, -10, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))) OR (started_at IS NULL AND created_at < TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, -1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3))))
